Forget saving humanity. Let's talk about what you, personally, get out of this. You don't need to be a good person to support this plan. You just need to be selfish.

## Your Actual Odds Right Now

If you get sick (and you will), your chances of getting into a clinical trial are **0.2%**, that's 1 in 480 people with chronic disease.

![A comparison showing the massive gap between the 50 percent of people willing to participate in clinical trials and the 0.2 percent who actually gain access due to system capacity limits.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-your-actual-odds-right-now-bw-academic.jpg)

Half of humanity is willing to participate [@patient-willingness-clinical-trials], but the system can only handle [5 million people per year](../appendix/clinical-trial-participants.qmd). The other 99.8% get to die while waiting for approval.

## What You Actually Get

**If you're sick, or will ever get sick:**

Instead of waiting 17 years for a cure that may never come, you get immediate access to subsidized clinical trials for every disease. Your chance of survival goes from near-zero to "actually possible."

![A comparison showing the shift from a 17-year wait for medical cures with near-zero survival odds to immediate access to subsidized clinical trials with increased survival chances.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-what-you-actually-get-bw-academic.jpg)

## If you're healthy (for now)

As diseases are cured, healthcare costs plummet. A 1% treaty expands clinical trial capacity by {{< var dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier >}} ({{< var trial_capacity_cumulative_years_20yr >}} trial-capacity-equivalent years in 20 years). That means cancer, heart disease, Alzheimer's, all tackled simultaneously by gene therapy, AI drug discovery, stem cells, and epigenetics.

![A comparison showing current clinical trial capacity versus the 12.3x expansion under a 1% treaty, illustrating how 246 years of medical progress is compressed into a 20-year window.](/assets/images/your-personal-benefits/your-personal-benefits-section-if-you-re-healthy-for-now-bw-academic.jpg)

#### If you have a family

Your parents won't die of Alzheimer's. Your children won't have to worry about rare diseases. You get to keep the people you love.

### The Math

The calculation is simple: **years of healthy life gained × economic value per healthy year**.

{{< var personal_lifetime_wealth_latex >}}

With median estimates:

- **Life extension**: {{< var life_extension_years >}}
- **QALY value**: {{< var standard_economic_qaly_value_usd >}}
- **Personal benefit**: {{< var personal_lifetime_wealth >}}

This uses the same methodology economists use to evaluate all health interventions.
